_comment: Which Nave's Topical Bible subjects the Themes tab may name. At Study, a verse that no theme reaches shows the Nave's subjects that list it (crates/atlas-cli/src/naves.rs). Only subjects about a concept can show: people, places and other names never do. This file hides subjects whose heading would mislead a reader today: a word that is offensive or means something else in modern English, a list about the Bible or a figure of speech rather than a subject in it, a subject so broad it says nothing about the verse, and the few names the build's name lists miss.
hide: one entry per subject. key: the subject exactly as Nave's table writes it (the build stops on a key it does not have). why: a short reason.
This list applies to the Themes tab only. Ask the Bible still lists every subject.
